You can buy it from here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/752540/AllStar_Fruit_Racing__Yogscast_Exclusive_DLC/

WHAT'S NEW

° Second Online implementation: Championship, Lobby Edit, all Race Modes and Invitations are now all accessible and playable also online!

More power to the host! After the lobby has been created the host will be able to customize the AI difficulty and the total number of tracks (from 1 to 6). The host will be able to pick tracks among all the 21 available in the game (provided that he has unlocked each and every one of them :). 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/071555ae6f64e505f597ca9ab041a6ac56d7fd29.gif

Clients will be able to race on tracks they haven't already unlocked offline in online mode exclusively (provided the host did it). "Invite Friend" button will open a Steam overlay letting you choose which friend to invite!

° Please refer to the "Online Known Issues" below in order to understand what is not working at the moment and please share your feedback, bugs, and comments on "Online - Second Implementation" discussion.
- New characters unlocked: Kiwi, Raspberry and Clementine!
- Apple Pikes and Poseimon tracks have been updated and transformed from point to point tracks into full circuits! Apple Pikes now is the longest track of the game :)

https://i.imgur.com/HiJwNpR.gif

FIXES
- FPS improved on Split Screen and menus
- Slightly improved online stability
- Several achievements and unlockables have been fixed
- AI behaviour on-track improved – its now less random and more realistic
- Some localization fixes
- Several minor fixes

https://i.imgur.com/jpGCIws.gif

KNOWN ISSUES
- Bonnet camera needs several optimizations
- Pad disconnection during race still needs to be managed accordingly
- A few issues in Elimination mode
- French, German and Spanish localisations not available on the new features (we are working on the translation but they are only in English for now)
- Rare freeze on loading screens (if you find a consistent repro steps please let us know! :) )
- Some LOD issues

https://i.imgur.com/8QDh1Fr.gif

ONLINE KNOWN ISSUES
- In order to put the focus on a specific lobby to join on the lobby list the only way to do it is to press TAB button until the focus is over the desired lobby
- Sometimes podium is not displayed 
- Sometimes the track overprint shown at the beginning of the race is incorrect
- Pausing the race before ending it will cause instability issues for all players in the same lobby
- Accepting invites in peculiar situations (into other modes, into another lobby, etc..) could cause instability issues for all players in the same lobby
- Disconnection error messages have been improved but are still WIP
- On some tracks the animations are not working properly when playing online, for example the dinosaur “Pear-Ex” in the Dino Juice track ......is Pear-Ex ok for you?:)

Fresh news! We are working on a new fantastic island! 

https://i.imgur.com/oY6Tor5.gif

https://i.imgur.com/KBJa1FL.gif

https://i.imgur.com/0jRMbtG.gif


Wishing you and your family a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

ːsteamhappyː *What's New* ːsteamhappyː
- The very first........ O N L I N E implementation!  
The player now is able to create lobbies and join browsing them (remember to update the lobby list using "Refresh" button). 
The Host is able to select a track, track length, race mode and difficulty. Host and Client can both change the character and the kart preset while waiting for the race to start.
At the moment only two race modes are available (Juicer and Random Juicer) and the only way to change the track selected is to quit the lobby and create another one.
When the Host selects "Ready" a 30 seconds countdown starts and when it finishes the race starts. Clients are able to shorten the countdown to 10 seconds only if every one of them have pressed the "Ready" button.
If a Client disconnects during the race an AI will take control of the kart.

notes.title: DEVBLOG #7 - PLAY TOGETHER!
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/ca9799106938b1c5cae527e1899821b8896c3b2f.png

Hi, there! 3DClouds here! As many of you already know we are working hard in order to complete the Online Mode. We are also working on all the community advice and feedback so you can have what you've asked in terms of implementations and new contents :)

We're late but.. Happy Halloween :) So, would you like to play on a track inspired by Halloween? Trick or treat?

https://i.imgur.com/pLEQZiG.gif
 
We are fully aware that the things to improve are many and of a wide variety... For this reason, we are taking the right time to complete these tasks. Thank you for all the support and discussions opened on our socials and Discord channel to assist us to improve the game.

https://i.imgur.com/cUIg7ke.gif
 
Kart poll
In the past days, we have asked you which kart you prefer the most from a selection given. Well, the winner is the kart number 6! Honestly, we didn't expect this result 'cause the number 6 is the most similar to the real ones. We thought you'd like a very different shape, but "the player is always right" so we will add it in the game as promised :D

New polls and contests are waiting for you, stay tuned!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/dae6c15f30a81d91a790a39961967038b8db937a.jpg


Unlockables System
In the next update (available within a few days) we are going to implement a brand new page that will help you unlock....everything! Throughout this page, you'll find all the unlockables items in the game in order to obtain them all!

https://i.imgur.com/nuLQZAk.gif

 
Online Mode
There we are, straight to the point! We nearly got the job done. A first release of the  Online Mode  will be available in the upcoming update together with everything we listed so far.

At the very beginning, everyone will be able to create a lobby and join them.
We decided to implement only the basic flow (for the moment) in order to get as much feedback as possible from you and test the servers' efficiency. 

Subsequently, we will implement the rank system, Championship mode, and other game modes. You'll have all the tracks in the game and you can join up to 8 players. The first mode we'll implement will be Random Juicer race.
 
Going into Online mode the game will load the last custom kart saved and the last character selected, then you will be able to choose another character and/or customize your kart. All unlockables available in this mode will be the ones you have already unlocked playing the game so far.
 
After this update, we will continue working on the other features.
For example, on the right side of the page, you'll have all the lobbies listed by ranking and number of players (rankings will be available shortly).
 
These will be the options that will be able to perform the user once the implementation in-game will be complete:
- Search for custom Races
- Search for custom Championships
- Host a custom race or a custom Championship
 
Upon joining Custom Race and Custom Championship lobbies the player will be put into the most populated lobby with a similar ranking. The host will be able to start a race only if at least a single has joined the lobby. When the Host pushes the "Start" button a 30 seconds countdown is played before the race starts. The countdown is reduced to 10 seconds if all clients available press the "Ready" button.

 
We're so excited to this update and we can't wait to look for your feedback. 
Other features will be added soon! Stay Tuned and play together! 

https://i.imgur.com/iM4wFoy.gif

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/ca9799106938b1c5cae527e1899821b8896c3b2f.png

Hi, there! 3DClouds here! As many of you already know we are working hard in order to complete the Online Mode. We are also working on all the community advice and feedback so you can have what you've asked in terms of implementations and new contents :)

We're late but.. Happy Halloween :) So, would you like to play on a track inspired by Halloween? Trick or treat?

https://i.imgur.com/pLEQZiG.gif
 
We are fully aware that the things to improve are many and of a wide variety... For this reason, we are taking the right time to complete these tasks. Thank you for all the support and discussions opened on our socials and Discord channel to assist us to improve the game.

https://i.imgur.com/cUIg7ke.gif
 
Kart poll
In the past days, we have asked you which kart you prefer the most from a selection given. Well, the winner is the kart number 6! Honestly, we didn't expect this result 'cause the number 6 is the most similar to the real ones. We thought you'd like a very different shape, but "the player is always right" so we will add it in the game as promised :D

New polls and contests are waiting for you, stay tuned!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/dae6c15f30a81d91a790a39961967038b8db937a.jpg


Unlockables System
In the next update (available within a few days) we are going to implement a brand new page that will help you unlock....everything! Throughout this page, you'll find all the unlockables items in the game in order to obtain them all!

https://i.imgur.com/nuLQZAk.gif

 
Online Mode
There we are, straight to the point! We nearly got the job done. A first release of the  Online Mode  will be available in the upcoming update together with everything we listed so far.

At the very beginning, everyone will be able to create a lobby and join them.
We decided to implement only the basic flow (for the moment) in order to get as much feedback as possible from you and test the servers' efficiency. 

Subsequently, we will implement the rank system, Championship mode, and other game modes. You'll have all the tracks in the game and you can join up to 8 players. The first mode we'll implement will be Random Juicer race.
 
Going into Online mode the game will load the last custom kart saved and the last character selected, then you will be able to choose another character and/or customize your kart. All unlockables available in this mode will be the ones you have already unlocked playing the game so far.
 
After this update, we will continue working on the other features.
For example, on the right side of the page, you'll have all the lobbies listed by ranking and number of players (rankings will be available shortly).
 
These will be the options that will be able to perform the user once the implementation in-game will be complete:
- Search for custom Races
- Search for custom Championships
- Host a custom race or a custom Championship
 
Upon joining Custom Race and Custom Championship lobbies the player will be put into the most populated lobby with a similar ranking. The host will be able to start a race only if at least a single has joined the lobby. When the Host pushes the "Start" button a 30 seconds countdown is played before the race starts. The countdown is reduced to 10 seconds if all clients available press the "Ready" button.

 
We're so excited to this update and we can't wait to look for your feedback. 
Other features will be added soon! Stay Tuned and play together! 

https://i.imgur.com/iM4wFoy.gif

notes.title: DEV BLOG #5 - WEEKLY UPDATES
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9a688499b1f320ad70d503373be2711cb8b1fe01.png

Hey, folks!
Here we are with fruity and cool updates you cannot miss!

We would love to thank you for the feedbacks received. It's very important to us in order to improve the quality of All-Star Fruit Racing. There are a few things that we would be able to fix in a short time and others which will require more time and resources. We have spent hours and hours to listen, watching videos and reading your comments, your reviews etc... Every information from you is very inspiring for us!

MILAN GAMES WEEK 2017

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/8348051a11339a06bea13fe371d4785ccd41fe28.png

We'd like to remind you our participation at Milan Games Week 2017 – from September 29th to October 1st. The majority of 3DClouds team is formed by italians and Milan Games Week event is the best video games exhibition in Italy so we are very proud of it. Our game has been admitted to be one of the 40 best indie games in Italy in 2017! Come by and say hi!

NEW UPDATES COMING

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9ecdaed16707588c1c9b7c06fd80eebc0bc10099.png

The next update will be a lovely gift to all the players that decided to trust in 3DClouds buying All-Star Fruit Racing during Steam Early Access! Up until now, you have been able to race at best on 2 Pistons difficulty... from now on you will be able to reach 3 Pistons difficulty which is the most challenging one in the game! Furthermore, 7 more cups have been added in Career mode... and a brand new island featuring 5 amazing tracks!

New characters and kart customizations will be available to unlock, check out the unlockables list to figure out how to unlock them!

FIFTH ISLAND

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/ce3def269bfcde62327381e52c9a755d9ff41eca.png

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/25cc808e5cdf99c9fe2a8e51b1213f4b84ede3db.png

Four seasons, for us, were not enough so we decided to create a new one assembling all the ideas we gathered throughout the production flow. We decided to share these contents with you, please let us know if you like them and share your opinions about new potential tracks based on locations we didn't have considered so far! Maybe in the future, who knows :P 

Some clues about the tracks
- Savana Core: located in Africa. This track is inspired to famous classic animated movies!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/234761a8081cfe2a38d3789b67debad2f17147a5.png
- Seed Cloud: a race through the clouds, towards the Olympus of fruit!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/1aa8845439b0cdb41475096fe912c5639daddbae.png
- Poseimon: an underwater track! Which kind of fruit grows underwater?
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/1433c87abfe858decf19e6381e1b09f64b5c50b8.png
- Taj Dates: this come directly from an oriental fairy tale.. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/754c6a90745d719467d73a1b80f45835f5477152.jpg
- AFR Shake: a space track? Why not!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/d96a690bcbe83734a00d0d2e59826b6400c750da.png

In the past days you asked us to implement a lot of new cool stuff, here you can find everything we already did and the work we have made so far: we're still working on the online to make it perfect. We want you to experience the best out of our product!

We're working on an experimental new physics system for the karts which we are going to share with you and adjust based on your feedbacks if it works as intended. This will radically change the actual drift system. In our opinion, it could be really fun!


CHANGELOG (update coming 22nd September, sorry for the delay)

- Game performances improved 
- Several localization fixes
- Drift mechanic tweaked: now you will no longer lose your boost accumulated when you hit an object if you press the drift button as fast as you can 
- 1 piston difficulty - now easier
- 2 piston difficulty - now easier
- 3 piston difficulty added
- 5 new tracks 
- 1 new island (unlockable achieving the 3rd place on last 2 pistons cup available up until the previous update)
- New unlockable characters 
- Several skills effects have been slightly changed 
- boost pads overrides negative effects suffered
- Fixed a bug on Random Juicer mode that affected several PC configurations causing inability to launch special moves
- Vehicles weight more realistic 
- Tuned collisions among vehicles
- Motion blur option added on settings page
- Left and right camera view now is immediately set in the correct position pressing the proper button
- Several particles optimizations

WORK IN PROGRESS:
- Improved drift system
- Experimental characters' size changes

and...






We're also working on this one! ːsteammockingː

https://i.imgur.com/FXXgXv7.gif

notes.title: Gameplay Modes: Random Juicer & Juicer
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/39cb0ff7140965021c5b2b68c52bbcf78e7449dd.png

Hi guys,

we are really excited! All-Star Fruit Racing will be released in Early Access in a few hours! This project is very important for us and, we fervently hope that All-Star Fruit Racing will become one of your favorite games!

As announced before, we'll be working hard to release a new update every week. Our goal is to release, as soon as possible, the online multiplayer. We are perfectioning some online details but, first of all, we prefer you training for the big online challenges.

We recommend to start immediately with Career Mode: in this way, you can unlock new characters, new tracks and new difficulty levels, as soon as possible. So you'll begin to taste the game a little by little.

At Day 1 of Early Access, you can play 2 different Gameplay Modes: RANDOM JUICER and JUICER. Dragster, Elimination and Elimination Mix will be added during Early Access, as soon as they are ready.


In this DevBlog #3, we explain the first two Gameplay Modes.

 
RANDOM JUICER

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/a7887641f986979c28f376275812a4356084ce0b.gif

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/654fcdf602e271d99ff306a8a08a6fe1b3850d18.gif

It is the less strategic mode: Random Juicer is perfect for a new player because it gives the chance to learn and to become familiar with tracks, characters, racing formats and other essential features.

https://i.imgur.com/FQx0Id0.gif

In the Random Juicer mode, players collect a “surprise” bubble which gives a random move, within all available! 


JUICER

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/0e9a059961b4cf7ed3ba6b8d09e3a96325dc9632.png

https://i.imgur.com/J9XZNIk.gif
https://i.imgur.com/qYg3IbB.gif

It is the main gameplay mode: players collect fruits on track, during the race, to fill the tanks.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/0d921fd542c656f39808e1ca959d8e2c07f7fe87.png

This gameplay feature is the Juice Extractor System (the Juicer): positioned on the back of each kart the juicer blends fruits that are collected on track during the race. The resulting fresh juice obtained can be used to unleash unique Skills and Powers for your kart. 

Once you have filled a tank you can unleash a power move to gain advantage over your opponents. If you have two or more tanks full then you can choose to use a combo move, the more tanks that are full the stronger the combo move.

https://i.imgur.com/cYraoSN.gif

Patience however is a virtue, wait until all four tanks are full and you can throw a “Mega-Juice” skill. Each pilot has its own unique “Mega-Juice” move that can only be used if all four tanks are full, these power moves if used correctly and strategically have the potential to turn a race on its head. 

Gameplay is easy to learn, hard to master. An expert gamer can choose more difficult tracks in order to collect more fruit and can also manually deactivate their karts tanks. 

Below, you can see the keyboard and gamepad controls.

If you need something more detailed let us know and we'll arrange a new gameplay video!

https://i.imgur.com/3fc5K9s.gif
https://i.imgur.com/qwV3olW.gif

notes.title: DEVBLOG #01 - Why Fruits?
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/BEMchCS.png

Hi Fruit Racers,

As you know last Thursday we announced the  4th of September  as our early access go live date. The response so far has been great but it has already thrown up lots of questions that we can reply to already.

 FPS 

Some concerns were raised that in the trailer the frame rate appeared to drop in multiscreen, the trailer was created from a version of the game from a couple of months ago and was already stable. Having said that we have improved the fps even further during the last two months and will continue to do so throughout the early access. We are happy with where we are but are striving to improve further.

http://i.imgur.com/8PjGSx2.gif

 GAMEPLAY 

A kart racing game lives or dies with its gameplay, our aim is for the game to be easy to play but hard to master indeed it’s our mantra. We added a strategic element with the powerups to ensure player engagement, let us explain more. 

Each kart has a juicer on the back and each juicer contains 4 tanks. Fill each tank by collecting the relevant fruit along the track. Once 1 tank is full you can use a special move however if wait until 2 tanks are full then the special move will be more powerful and even more so with 3 full tanks. Now wait until all 4 tanks are full and you can use your mega-juice move, each character has a unique special mega-juice move you will need to try them all to find your favourite.

http://i.imgur.com/4YombnI.gif

 CHARACTERS 
 
We read several comments about the fact that All-Star Fruit Racing has an all-female cast some positive and some less so. We wanted to leave just a little bit more of suspense but... 😊 The cast is male and female although the majority​​​ are female.  We sketched dozens of characters and simply chose the ones we liked the most of which are of the gentler sex.  p.s. we discarded the characters that we thought were too sexy as it was not the feel we were looking for.

http://i.imgur.com/G7sZMXB.jpg

 FRUIT 

Fruit why fruit?  This is our first game so obviously we don’t have a catalogue of characters to pull from so we needed something else that everyone could identify with. Fruit ticked all the right boxes as everyone recognises fruit and almost everyone thinks of fruit with a degree of affection. Most importantly a fruit theme gave our artists incredible flexibility and really go their “Fruit juices” flowing (sorry couldn’t resist). Join our early access and you can see if you can spot the several tributes to our favourite movies.

But there's more to it.... 

http://i.imgur.com/liu6jRj.gif

 INSPIRATION 

Lots of comments regarding Mario / CTR / Sonic and the Sugar Rush game in the film Wreck It Ralph, we love all of these games and films and we played and watched them constantly during our design period so yes of course they had an influence but it was only a starting point. We really hope to have brought a new dimension to kart racing for sure it’s the first true next gen kart racer and nothing previous has had the cool fresh look of fruit or the not so hidden tributes mentioned earlier.
 
Keep your questions and comments coming and remember All-Star Fruit Racing available 4th September in Early Access.
